findings.title: Discount rate is a float instead of an int
findings.body: The new `spring_price_cents` function passes `rate = 0.2` to `apply_discount`, which expects an `int` percent. Passing a float here will cause incorrect rounding in the discount calculation. Use an integer rate (e.g., 20) to match the function's contract.

summary.problem: The spring sale price function uses a float discount rate instead of an integer, violating the contract of `apply_discount`.
summary.done_well: The new function clearly documents its purpose and uses the existing `apply_discount` helper.
